name: Rotating observatory dome

parts.name: body
parts.massBasis: Circular concrete-and-steel foundation ring, 8.3 m dia × 1.37 m tall. Hollow interior for telescope access; effective solid fraction ~35 % of bounding cylinder. Near-uniform mass distribution about vertical axis; slight COM shift down due to thicker base slab.

parts.name: support pier
parts.massBasis: Solid cast-concrete instrument pier, 1.07 m square × 2.05 m tall. Nearly uniform density; variance factors ≈ 1/12 for a solid rectangular column. Slight anchoring flange at base does not shift COM appreciably.

parts.name: dome rotation
parts.massBasis: Hemispherical steel shell (~4 mm) on light framing, ~7.8 m dia, 2.5 m rise. Surface area ~67 m² gives shell mass ~2100 kg plus ribs/ring. COM below mid-height because dome curvature concentrates area lower. Variance below 1/12 reflecting thin-shell surface distribution.

parts.name: slit shutter
parts.massBasis: Two thin steel shutter leaves (~2.5 mm) covering the observation slit, total panel area ≈ 6 m² plus edge frames. Nearly symmetric; thin in the radial direction so z-variance is small. Centered within its bounding box.
